id: 06_BIORISK MANAGEMENT DOUBLE BAGGING OF HAZARDOUS WASTES INSIDE BSC
title: 安全柜里的废物收尾
source_doc: course/BIORISK MANAGEMENT/06_BIORISK MANAGEMENT DOUBLE BAGGING OF HAZARDOUS WASTES INSIDE BSC.md
author_source: project/BIORISK MANAGEMENT/06_BIORISK MANAGEMENT DOUBLE BAGGING OF HAZARDOUS WASTES INSIDE BSC/src.py

points.S2: 出柜前：外袋消毒，换手套

shots.scene: 欣欣站在生物安全柜旁，柜内放着一个套袋的废物桶和喷壶
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside a biological safety cabinet with a lined waste bin and a spray bottle inside, and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 实验做完了，安全柜里怎么收尾？

shots.scene: 小研做完实验，柜内废物桶快满了
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student finishes an experiment; the lined waste bin in the cabinet is nearly three quarters full.
shots.narration: 小研做完实验，准备收拾废物。

shots.scene: 阿杰站在旁边拿着空白笔记本
shots.prompt_en: The young male student stands beside her holding a blank notebook, ready to learn.
shots.narration: 阿杰在旁边跟着学。

shots.scene: 阿杰伸手想直接把桶端出柜外，小研摇头
shots.prompt_en: The young male student reaches to carry the whole bin straight out of the cabinet; the female graduate student shakes her head.
shots.narration: 他想把桶直接端出去，小研拦住了。

shots.scene: 柜外，小研把两只袋套进空桶，旁边放着喷壶
shots.prompt_en: Outside the cabinet, the female graduate student fits two blank bags into an empty bin, with a disinfectant spray bottle beside it.
shots.narration: 收尾从开工前就开始了：

shots.scene: 套好两层袋的桶和喷壶放在柜内台面后部
shots.prompt_en: The double-lined bin and the spray bottle stand toward the back of the cabinet work surface. No people.
shots.narration: 桶先套两层袋，喷壶放在手边。

shots.scene: 小研拿喷壶向内袋口里喷消毒剂
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student sprays disinfectant into the open inner bag in the cabinet.
shots.narration: 收口前，先往内袋里喷消毒剂。

shots.scene: 雾滴落在袋内废物上的示意
shots.prompt_en: Fine disinfectant mist settling over used tips and dishes inside the bag. No people.
shots.narration: 让废物表面先接触消毒剂。

shots.scene: 双手把内袋口收拢、提起
shots.prompt_en: Gloved hands gather the top of the inner bag and lift it gently. No people.
shots.narration: 把内袋口轻轻收拢，

shots.scene: 袋口拧成一股，不挤压袋身
shots.prompt_en: The bag top is twisted into a neck without squeezing the bag body. No people.
shots.narration: 拧成一股，别挤压袋子。

shots.scene: 扎带和胶带缠在袋颈上
shots.prompt_en: A zip tie and a band of tape wrapped around the twisted bag neck. No people.
shots.narration: 用扎带扎住，再缠胶带。

shots.scene: 挤压袋子冒出气雾，被打叉
shots.prompt_en: A hand squeezing air out of a waste bag with a puff of mist, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 不要把袋里的空气挤出来。

shots.scene: 喷壶对着扎好的袋颈补喷
shots.prompt_en: The spray bottle mists disinfectant over the tied neck of the inner bag. No people.
shots.narration: 扎好后，在扎口处再补喷一次。

shots.scene: 扎口处的手套接触点被标出
shots.prompt_en: Highlighted spots where the gloves touched the bag neck. No people.
shots.narration: 手碰过的地方，最容易沾污染。

shots.scene: 双手把外袋从桶沿翻起
shots.prompt_en: Gloved hands lift the outer bag up from the rim of the bin. No people.
shots.narration: 然后把外袋从桶沿翻起来，

shots.scene: 外袋把内袋整个包住
shots.prompt_en: The outer bag wraps completely around the tied inner bag. No people.
shots.narration: 把内袋整个包在里面。

shots.scene: 外袋口拧紧、扎好
shots.prompt_en: The outer bag top is twisted and secured with a zip tie. No people.
shots.narration: 同样拧紧，扎好第二道口。

shots.scene: 小研把扎口上方多余的袋子折好、压平
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student folds down the loose plastic above the tie and presses it flat inside the cabinet.
shots.narration: 扎口多余的部分，整理整齐。

shots.scene: 轻拉扎口检查是否松动
shots.prompt_en: Gloved hands give the tied neck a gentle tug to check it holds. No people.
shots.narration: 轻轻拉一拉，确认扎牢了。

shots.scene: 双手把双层废物袋从桶里提出来
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student lifts the double bag out of the bin with both hands.
shots.narration: 把双层废物袋从桶里提出来。

shots.scene: 袋面上的生物危害标志和灭菌器图标
shots.prompt_en: A bag printed with a biohazard warning sign and a small autoclave icon. No people.
shots.narration: 袋子耐高压灭菌，印着生物危害标志。

shots.scene: 小研向空桶外表面喷消毒剂
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student sprays disinfectant on the outside of the empty bin.
shots.narration: 空桶外面，也喷上消毒剂。

shots.scene: 桶身被擦拭，旁边计时器图标
shots.prompt_en: The empty bin wiped clean, with a timer icon beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 等够作用时间，再擦干净。

shots.scene: 小研把废物袋移出柜外，放进带盖的转运桶
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student moves the tied bag out of the cabinet into a lidded transport bin with a biohazard warning sign.
shots.narration: 最后把废物袋移出安全柜，

shots.scene: 转运桶指向高压灭菌器图标
shots.prompt_en: An arrow from the lidded transport bin to an autoclave icon. No people.
shots.narration: 按规程送去灭菌处置。

shots.scene: 柜内只剩空桶和喷壶，台面整洁
shots.prompt_en: Inside the cabinet only the empty bin and the spray bottle remain on a clean work surface. No people.
shots.narration: 收尾时，柜里只留必需的东西。

shots.scene: 台面擦拭后，柜内照明关闭
shots.prompt_en: The work surface has been wiped and the cabinet light switches off. No people.
shots.narration: 台面擦拭消毒，关上照明。

shots.scene: 柜内紫外灯亮起，柜前无人
shots.prompt_en: A violet ultraviolet lamp glows inside the closed cabinet; nobody stands in front of it. No people.
shots.narration: 紫外灯只作辅助，开灯时人离开。

shots.scene: 提袋时袋底渗出液滴，红色感叹号
shots.prompt_en: A drop of liquid leaks from the bottom of a waste bag as it is lifted, with a red exclamation icon. No people.
shots.narration: 装袋时发现袋子破了、渗漏，

shots.scene: 小研停下，把破袋放回桶里，不拿出柜外
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student calmly stops and lowers the leaking bag back into the bin inside the cabinet.
shots.narration: 先停下，别把它拿出柜外。

shots.scene: 在破袋外面再套一只新袋
shots.prompt_en: A fresh bag is pulled over the torn bag inside the cabinet. No people.
shots.narration: 在外面再套一只新袋，扎紧。

shots.scene: 漏液处盖吸水纸、倒消毒剂
shots.prompt_en: Absorbent paper covers the leaked drops on the work surface and disinfectant is poured over it. No people.
shots.narration: 漏出的液体，盖纸倒消毒剂处理。

shots.scene: 手套被溅湿的图标，箭头指向换手套
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a wet glove with an arrow to a fresh pair of gloves. No people.
shots.narration: 手套沾上了，马上更换。

shots.scene: 小研向王老师报告
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student reports the leak to the safety administrator, who writes in a blank log.
shots.narration: 处理完，报告负责人并记录。

shots.section_title: 出柜前：外袋消毒，换手套
shots.scene: 喷壶对着扎好的双层袋外表面喷洒
shots.prompt_en: Disinfectant is sprayed over the entire outside of the tied double bag inside the cabinet. No people.
shots.narration: 移出柜外之前，外袋表面也要消毒。
overlay: 出柜前：外袋消毒，换手套

shots.section_title: 出柜前：外袋消毒，换手套
shots.scene: 没消毒的袋子被直接拎出柜外，打叉
shots.prompt_en: A bag carried straight out of the cabinet without disinfecting, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 直接拎出去，会把污染带出来。

shots.section_title: 出柜前：外袋消毒，换手套
shots.scene: 小研戴两层手套，脱下外层手套丢进柜内废物桶
shots.prompt_en: Wearing two pairs of gloves, the female graduate student peels off the outer pair inside the cabinet and drops it into a waste bin.
shots.narration: 戴双层手套的，先在柜内脱外层。

shots.section_title: 出柜前：外袋消毒，换手套
shots.scene: 换上干净手套，再提起袋子
shots.prompt_en: With clean gloves on, she lifts the disinfected bag out of the cabinet.
shots.narration: 用干净的手，把袋子拿出来。

shots.scene: 阿杰穿着隔离衣和手套走向门口，被打叉
shots.prompt_en: The young male student walks toward the laboratory door still wearing his gown and gloves, crossed out with a red X.
shots.narration: 防护用品，不能穿出实验室。

shots.scene: 脱手套、脱隔离衣、摘护目镜的顺序图标
shots.prompt_en: Three numbered icons in order: removing gloves, removing the gown, removing goggles. No people.
shots.narration: 按规定顺序，一件一件脱。

shots.scene: 隔离衣外面朝里卷起
shots.prompt_en: A gown being rolled up with the outside surface turned inward. No people.
shots.narration: 脏的一面朝里，别碰到身上。

shots.scene: 脱下的用品放进对应的废物桶或回收袋
shots.prompt_en: Removed gloves go into a biohazard bin and the reusable gown into a blank laundry bag. No people.
shots.narration: 一次性的丢弃，重复用的按规程处理。

shots.scene: 阿杰在水池边洗手后离开
shots.prompt_en: The young male student washes his hands at the sink, then leaves the laboratory.
shots.narration: 最后洗手，再离开实验室。

shots.scene: 液体培养瓶倒向水池，被打叉
shots.prompt_en: A liquid culture flask being poured into a sink drain, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 液体培养物，不能直接倒下水道。

shots.scene: 液体废物收集在带盖容器里，加入消毒剂
shots.prompt_en: Liquid waste collected in a lidded container with a biohazard warning sign, disinfectant being added. No people.
shots.narration: 收集在带盖容器里，按规程消毒，

shots.scene: 容器指向高压灭菌器图标
shots.prompt_en: An arrow from the lidded liquid waste container to an autoclave icon. No people.
shots.narration: 或者灭菌之后，再按规定处置。

shots.scene: 液体容器旁画着防溢托盘
shots.prompt_en: A liquid waste container standing in a spill tray. No people.
shots.narration: 容器放进托盘里，防止打翻。

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现两层袋、两道扎口、补喷的图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside icons of two bags, two tied necks and a spray bottle.
shots.narration: 两层袋，两道口，扎口补喷。

shots.scene: 外袋喷消毒剂、换手套、移出柜外图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of spraying the outer bag, changing gloves and moving the bag out of the cabinet. No people.
shots.narration: 外袋消毒、换手套，再移出柜外。

shots.scene: 破袋套新袋、脱防护顺序、液体容器图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a torn bag inside a new bag, numbered PPE removal steps and a lidded liquid waste container. No people.
shots.narration: 袋破套新袋，脱防护按顺序。

shots.scene: 打叉的水池和紫外灯图标
shots.prompt_en: A crossed-out sink drain icon and a small ultraviolet lamp icon. No people.
shots.narration: 液体不倒下水道，紫外只作辅助。

shots.scene: 欣欣和小研站在整洁的安全柜前挥手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot and the female graduate student stand in front of a clean biological safety cabinet and wave goodbye.
shots.narration: 收好尾，才算做完实验，再见！
